BBB.name: BBB
BBB.explanation:
Blood-Brain Barrier Penetration
Category 1: BBB+; Category 0: BBB-;
The output value is the probability of being BBB+

BCRP.name: BCRP
BCRP.explanation:
Category 0: Non-inhibitor; Category 1: inhibitor.
The output value is the probability of being inhibitor, within the range of 0 to 1.
